# server.llm

> Answers a prompt using whichever model provider is currently reachable.

<!-- Generated by scripts/modules/generate-agents.mjs from module.manifest.json
     and module.narrative.md. Edit those, not this file. -->

Two cooperating halves: `providers/` adapts each upstream API to one interface,
`routing/` decides which profile to try next.

Routing only engages when `LLM_ALLOWED_PROVIDERS` is set. Otherwise calls go straight to
`LLM_PROVIDER` on a legacy fast path — worth knowing before debugging why a failover ladder
appears not to run.

## Interface

Entrypoint: `index.ts`

Anything not listed here is internal to this module:

- `generateJson`
- `generateText`
- `createLlmProvider`
- `LlmProviderInterface`

## Children

Route by goal — you should not need to open more than one.

- **server.llm.providers** (`src/server/llm/providers`) — Adapts each upstream model API to one provider interface.
- **server.llm.routing** (`src/server/llm/routing`) — Chooses which provider profile to try next after a failure.
